I need to decide whether to pay this vendor invoice.

I am reviewing the payment policy. A "reject" finding blocks payment. Warnings and info findings do not block it alone. I must weigh them carefully. Invoices over $10,000 require explicit scrutiny of every finding and the risk memo. I will reject a high-risk memo.
